# Scalar manifest of the Nemotron vision tower's fp32 gates (crates/cuda/tests/nemotron_vit_fp32_gates.rs).
# Made by tools/nemotron_omni/vision_sdpa_check.py refs + manifest: `file` is the size and SHA-256 of each node-local reference file
# (never committed: activations of the pack's weights), `floor` the bf16 eager model's own rel_l2 to fp32 (worst stage for blocks),
# `engine` the engine's rel_l2 to fp32 when this manifest was made (printed beside the current numbers, not gated).
